next_owner.title: Production Accepted-State Operator & Bounded Stiffness-Aware Indicator Seam
next_owner.purpose: Implement the smallest solver-owned production seam needed to evaluate the qualified F-SI24/F-VQ30 indicator from the accepted final Richards state without exposing HeadCalc internals.

F_SI25_must_implement: A soil-water-solver-owned accepted-state operator evaluation contract sufficient to form the candidate final-state J/operator semantics.
B_M=min(||e_raw||_M,2||delta||_M) and B_inf=B_M/sqrt(min_i M_i) with the analytic factor 2 unchanged.
A result/diagnostic surface that exposes the indicator without silently introducing an acceptance tolerance or retry policy.
Bounded normal cost: zero extra full nonlinear Richards trajectories and at most one additional tridiagonal solve for the indicator.
Hard mass non-interference: no change to accepted state, accepted fluxes or water balance accounting.
Transactional correctness: trial/retry evaluation must not mutate committed state and rollback must remain exact.
Generic time semantics over the actual interval dt, with no calendar/day assumption.
Worker/scratch ownership of temporary operator vectors and defect-solve workspace; no unnecessary persistent per-column state.
Reference-mode visibility and per-column diagnostics suitable for later runtime qualification.
F_SI25_must_not_do: Do not expose, return or retain HeadCalc Jacobian/internal arrays outside the soil-water solver boundary.
Do not treat the current workspace dfdh array as the exact accepted-state J without a solver-owned reconstruction/evaluation contract.
Do not add N4/N8/N128/N256/N512 or any other deep refinement trajectory to the production normal path.
Do not fit a safety factor, global multiplier, material coefficient, floor inflation or temporal tolerance.
Do not turn B_inf into a production temporal acceptance criterion in F-SI25.
Do not claim B_inf is a true general nonlinear error upper bound.
Do not release F-GC02, groundwater coupling, F-PE or a production retry policy from this handoff alone.
Do not alter Richards physics, boundary physics or mass gates to make the indicator easier to satisfy.
qualification_replay_required_after_impl: Replay the exact F-VQ30 manufactured-linear regression against the production seam semantics.
Replay the frozen 16-case held-out matrix without changing its cases or qualification rules.
Verify O0/O2 deterministic identity under current conventions.
Verify hard mass and accepted-state/flux identity with the indicator disabled versus observer-enabled where applicable.
Verify actual production cost instrumentation shows no extra nonlinear trajectory and no more than one extra tridiagonal solve.
Independently qualify the production seam before any temporal tolerance or retry policy is admitted.
downstream_sequence_if_F_SI25_qualifies: F-MR/F-KT composition using live free numbering at start time, currently observed F-MR18 and F-KT10 but not reserved.
Independent production/scientific VQ of the implemented seam and any later acceptance policy.
Resume the same existing F-GC02 coupling workunit only after its temporal acceptance dependency is actually qualified.
Allow F-PE to re-enter only after the relevant production path is admitted.
carried_nonclaims: No true general nonlinear error bound is qualified.
No scientific temporal tolerance is selected.
F-VQ28 negative retry-translation evidence remains valid.
F-VQ29 finite-reference-strength negative evidence remains valid.
Held-out B_inf/E1_512 conservatism remains large and state/horizon dependent, observed range 6.685266816523914 to 102.49832534208181.
